title: Q&A - Helion Energy, NIF, Space and more
summary: A roughly three-hour technical livestream Q&A on Helion Energy's fusion approach and the National Ignition Facility. It covers neutron production, shielding, energy recovery, diagnostics and why tokamaks might fare better.
why: HN commenters cite it as a detailed critical counterpoint to Helion's claims, for those who want more than the hype.

quote.text: explains that 95% recovery efficiency is not the whole story
